problems.what: Contract gap (D3): there is no backend wait for picking a different model or for Unload. Only reload_local_model has when_idle, and reload_waiting / cancel_pending_reload cover only a reload of the current model. load_local_model(path, settings?) and unload_model() have no when_idle and no 'stop users first' meaning. WP1b and WP2 would have to change these signatures, and the shared append-only ipc.ts, while both work in parallel.
problems.evidence: spec.md:130-140 says the same question (Cancel / Restart when it ends / Stop and restart) appears for Reload, Unload, Apply and restart, and for picking a different local model (model list, Installed > Use, Welcome, first run), and that 'The backend implements the wait (reload_local_model(force, when_idle))'. But reload_local_model (src-tauri/src/models_cmd.rs:161) restarts only the current model and takes no path. load_local_model (models_cmd.rs:34) takes (path, settings: Option<LocalModelSettings>). unload_model (models_cmd.rs:105) takes no arguments. ipc.ts:137 is loadLocalModel(path, settings?) and ipc.ts:146 is unloadModel(). With these shapes, 'Restart when it ends' for a model switch or Unload has no backend path and no reload_waiting status.
problems.fix: Decide now, before WP1b/WP2 start. Either (a) add `when_idle: Option<bool>` to load_local_model and unload_model (the stubs ignore it), add optional `whenIdle?: boolean` to loadLocalModel/unloadModel in ipc.ts, and document that reload_waiting and cancel_pending_reload cover any waiting load, unload or reload; or (b) write into the contract that model switches and Unload wait in the webview (poll model_busy) and that the webview shows its own 'Restarts when the reply ends · Cancel' for them. (a) is a few lines in models_cmd.rs and ipc.ts.

problems.what: Contract gap: RuntimeStatusDto cannot show the 'unloaded' state that WP2 must display. After unload_model the status is reset to Default, so 'unloaded by the user' looks the same as 'never loaded' and the model's path is lost.
problems.evidence: spec.md:339 (WP2) asks for the unloaded state 'Unloaded to free memory · Load', and WP1b owns the 'unload_model wiring'. runtime_manager.rs:650 `self.update(|s| *s = RuntimeStatusDto::default());` clears model_path and model_name and leaves state=stopped. No WP0 field tells the webview that a model was unloaded, or which one. Nothing in src/store/app.ts or RuntimeIndicator.tsx tracks it either (grep -i unload: no matches).
problems.fix: Append one field to RuntimeStatusDto and to RuntimeStatus in types.ts, for example `unloaded_path: Option<String>` (set by unload_model, cleared by the next load, default None). The stub can leave it None. WP1b then sets it, and WP2 reads it.

problems.what: A failed load leaves a stale load_stage. The contract says load_stage is 'Set to Starting when a load begins and cleared on Ready', but the Failed branch never clears it, so a failed status still carries for example {kind:'readingModel'}.
problems.evidence: runtime_manager.rs:627-634, the ServerState::Failed branch, sets state, progress and error but not load_stage. Only the Ready callback (runtime_manager.rs:468) and unload (runtime_manager.rs:650) clear it. A WP2 indicator that treats a non-null loadStage as 'loading' would show a loading stage on a failed status.
problems.fix: Add `s.load_stage = None;` in the Failed branch, and document 'cleared on Ready and on Failed'. adjustments stay as they are, since they explain the failure.

problems.what: The default context for a fresh install is not decided. LocalModelSettings::default() has context_auto=false and ctx=8192, so a new user gets a fixed 8,192 tokens, while a 0.0.4 user with a stored 8,192 gets Automatic under the upgrade rule.
problems.evidence: dto.rs:219 `pub context_auto: bool` with `#[serde(default)]`, and dto.rs:247 `context_auto: false`. spec.md:124 covers only a stored ctx of exactly 8,192. settings.rs local_model_settings() falls back to unwrap_or_default() when no key is stored.
problems.fix: The lead decides whether a missing localModel key means Automatic. If it does, record that WP1b's resolver treats an absent key as Automatic, so dto.rs's Default does not need a later non-append edit.

problems.what: New files are not in the spec's Owns lists. The report assigns crates/runtime/src/llama/stage.rs to WP1a and crates/agent/src/thinking.rs to WP3a; Badge.tsx is lead-owned and Downloads.tsx has no owner. The spec's Part 3 lists none of them.

problems.fix: The lead adds these files to the owners' briefs.

problems.what: The webview gets no push when the busy counts change. WP2's 'Used by another app' line and its D3 indicator must poll model_busy or share_status.
problems.evidence: state.rs BusyCounter::subscribe() exists in Rust only. Nothing emits a busy event, and RuntimeStatusDto has no busy field.
problems.fix: Optional: emit 'model-busy' or include a ModelBusy snapshot in runtime-status, or tell WP2 to poll.

problems.what: FileFacts has no expert or active-parameter count, so WP4b's 'using N billion at a time' line is possible only for catalog entries (CatalogFacts.active_parameters).
problems.evidence: dto.rs FileFacts has only `moe: bool`. models::ModelSummary already has expert_count and expert_used_count.
problems.fix: Optional: append `expert_count` and `expert_used_count: Option<u64>` to FileFacts and FileFacts in types.ts, or accept the catalog-only line.

problems.what: All current loadLocalModel callers still pass the global defaults explicitly. Once WP1b lands its resolver, per-model settings are skipped until WP2 changes these calls to loadLocalModel(path).
problems.evidence: src/components/models/Installed.tsx:26, src/components/FirstRun.tsx:79 and src/store/app.ts:397 each call getLocalModelSettings() and then loadLocalModel(path, settings).
problems.fix: Name these call sites in WP2's brief. WP2 owns all three files.
